findings.scope: This narrow matched synthetic comparison; not a population rate or proof all rollback inputs regress.
findings.detection: All 12 requests detected en with score 1. Production would omit all 12 English variants.
findings.historical: Both arms lose spend and narrow until-after to the 24h post-close interval. Stay was not reproduced; no demonstrated action/scope fix.
findings.negation: Both arms preserve spending and do-not-yet.
findings.wait_then: Post adds 花时间 (spend time), versus pre 花钱 (spend money), in both trials; temporal sequencing remains intact.
blockers: Do not deploy the rollback as a validated semantic improvement: repeated wait/then action regression violates the agreed no-material-regression criterion.
Independent bilingual review remains outstanding, including action/object and full prohibition interval.
Historical until-after action and temporal errors persist; terminology and parser success cannot clear them.
Other implicated amount/Charitree and Fellowship rules retain their previously documented unresolved comparisons; no inference or authorization for new experiments.
Backend deployment and live verification remain separate, unperformed operations; no player history read or changed.
findings.next_action: Human decision on the harmful rollback and independent review; no automatic code repair, revert, deployment, or further provider requests.
